2026_05_LV_NE.headline: Cousins and Bowers challenge Patriots coverage after Maye’s Buffalo breakthrough
2026_05_LV_NE.paragraph1: Las Vegas arrives in Foxborough with one of the league’s more productive scoring offenses, built around Kirk Cousins and tight end Brock Bowers. New England counters with a defense that has limited passing yardage and a Drake Maye offense coming off its strongest outing against Buffalo. The Raiders must protect Cousins from pressure and improve a rushing attack that has lagged behind their passing production. New England needs Maye to avoid turnovers while finding consistent scoring opportunities against a Raiders defense that has been vulnerable on the ground. Red-zone execution could swing the game.
2026_05_LV_NE.model_rationale: Las Vegas can challenge New England’s coverage with its passing targets, but needs rushing balance. The Patriots can exploit defensive gaps if Maye maintains clean possessions.
